description:
Communities competing for Seedit's /s/todayilearned route. The highest-rated finalized candidate resolves the route. Subscriptions and post links continue to use exact community addresses.

https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists/blob/master/seedit-directories/seedit-todayilearned-directory.json
rules: Link directly to a reliable source that supports every factual claim in the title.
Share verifiable facts, not personal opinions, anecdotes, or subjective recommendations.
Avoid breaking news and very recent sources; this directory is for established knowledge.
Do not use the format for political advocacy, agenda pushing, or misleading claims.
Begin the title with 'TIL' or 'Today I Learned' and make it concise, specific, and understandable on its own.
Do not omit essential context or imply a connection the source does not establish.
